title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of NbMoTaW porous refractory high entropy alloy processed by powder metallurgy
process_description: prepared by mixing irregular W, Mo, Ta, and Nb elemental powders with a particle size of 1–5 μm in an equal atomic ratio for 8 h by a rotary pendulum mixer, followed by cold isostatic pressing at 220 MPa for 3 min to produce green bodies, and vacuum sintering at 2200 °C for 3 h with a heating rate of 10 °C/min.
